roles.purpose: Own the Agent Framework code in `src/concierge`: the agent, its workflow, tools, instructions and the ResponsesHostServer entry point, which change together whenever behavior changes.
knowledge: `src/concierge/main.py` builds `FoundryChatClient` from `FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT` and `AZURE_AI_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME` (local fallback `FOUNDRY_MODEL_NAME`) and serves the agent with `ResponsesHostServer`.
The hosting packages are prerelease: `src/concierge/uv.toml` allows prereleases and `src/concierge/uv.lock` pins them; update both together with `uv lock`.
`ResponsesHostServer` accepts an agent or a factory; a factory runs per request. Hosted sessions, checkpoints and pending tool approvals are persisted by the host's Foundry stores.
`@tool(approval_mode="always_require")` makes the host return an approval request instead of running the tool; the caller approves and continues with `previous_response_id`.
checks: `uv run pytest` passes in `src/concierge`, with the booking API and search mocked.
`azd ai agent run` starts the host and `azd ai agent invoke --local` answers a policy question with a citation.
nonNegotiables: Booking, changing or cancelling a trip is only possible through an approval-required tool.
No endpoint, key or model name in code.
roles.modelReason: Prerelease APIs, multi-step workflows and approval semantics need careful reasoning; a wrong tool contract can book a trip.

roles.purpose: Own `evals/` and tracing: golden datasets, groundedness, task adherence, tool-call accuracy and content safety evaluations, thresholds, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation in `src/concierge`.
knowledge: Azure AI Evaluation (`azure-ai-evaluation`) provides groundedness, task adherence, tool-call accuracy and content safety evaluators; safety evaluators need the Foundry project, not just a model endpoint.
The hosted runtime injects `APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING`; local traces need it set in `src/concierge/.env`.
checks: The evaluation run reports every metric against `evals/thresholds.json` and fails below a threshold.
Each new tool or policy rule adds at least one golden case.
nonNegotiables: Golden data contains no real traveller personal data.
Never lower a threshold to make a change pass.
roles.modelReason: Evaluation work follows documented SDK patterns; judgment is needed for good test cases, not for deep code reasoning.

roles.purpose: Own delivery: `azure.yaml`, `src/concierge/Dockerfile`, model deployments, the agent identity's role assignments and the GitHub Actions deploy workflow.
knowledge: `azure.yaml` uses `infra.provider: microsoft.foundry`, so `azd provision` creates the Foundry project and the deployments under the `ai-project` service; there is no Bicep yet.
`azd deploy` builds the image, creates a new agent version and waits until it is active; each deployed agent gets its own Entra agent identity.
Hosted agents need the azd extension (`azd ext install azure.ai.agents`); `azure.yaml` pins the minimum versions under requiredVersions.
checks: `docker build src/concierge` succeeds and the container serves on port 8088.
nonNegotiables: No keys or connection strings in `azure.yaml`, workflows or the image.
Role assignments for the agent identity are scoped to the resource it reads, never the subscription.
roles.modelReason: azd and Foundry configuration is declarative and documented; Microsoft Learn MCP covers the specifics.

roles.purpose: Review each feature PR for unsafe agent behavior: unapproved side effects, ungrounded policy answers, prompt-injection exposure through tools, leaked secrets and evaluation regressions.
knowledge: Tool results (search hits, booking API responses) are untrusted input to the model; instructions must not let them trigger other tools.
checks: Every tool with a side effect has approval_mode always_require and a test proving it.
The PR includes evaluation results for the changed behavior, at or above `evals/thresholds.json`.
nonNegotiables: Block a PR that adds a side-effecting tool without approval or lowers an evaluation threshold without a recorded decision.
roles.modelReason: A different model family from the main implementer gives an independent safety review at moderate cost.
